name: simple-social-media
description: A lightweight social media app built with FastAPI and Streamlit, featuring JWT authentication, image and video sharing, cloud media storage, and a SQLite database.

paragraphs: A full-stack social media web application built with Python, FastAPI, and Streamlit. Users can register, authenticate securely, upload images and videos with captions, and explore posts shared by other users. The application uses PostgreSQL for persistent data storage and ImageKit for cloud media hosting.
features: User Authentication: User registration and login with JWT-based authentication using FastAPI Users.
Media Sharing: Upload images and videos with captions.
Social Feed: Browse posts with media, captions, author information, and timestamps.
Post Management: Delete your own posts with backend ownership verification.
Cloud Media Storage: Store and serve uploaded media through ImageKit.
